headline: Wall Street me badi girawat, Nasdaq 5.5% gira
detail: America ke share bazaar me 5 November ko badi girawat aayi; Nasdaq 5.52% gira aur correction me chala gaya, jabki S&P 500 4.36% aur Dow 3.44% gira.
exam_angle: America ki arthvyavastha aur share bazaar — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Bank of England ne byaj dar 4% ki
detail: Bank of England ne byaj dar 3.75% se badha kar 4% kar di, teen saal me pehli badhotri; MPC ne 8-1 se faisla liya aur mahangai ke 5% tak jaane ka anumaan lagaya.
exam_angle: Kendriya bank aur byaj dar — banking aur arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: KOSPI 8% gira, circuit breaker laga
detail: South Korea ka KOSPI subah ke karobar me 8% se zyada gira aur 5,000 ke neeche chala gaya, jisse 20 minute ke liye karobar roka gaya; Samsung aur SK hynix ke share bhi buri tarah gire.
exam_angle: Asia ke share bazaar aur AI stock girawat — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Turkey ne teen-desh raksha samjhauta manzoor kiya
detail: Turkey ki sansad ne Saudi Arabia aur Pakistan ke saath Mecca raksha samjhaute ko 279 ke muqable 119 maton se manzoor kiya; samjhaute ke tahat ek desh par hamla teeno par hamla mana jayega.
exam_angle: Samoohik raksha aur paschim Asia ki suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Serbia me chhatra andolan ko 140 seatein
detail: Serbia ke chunav aayog ne antim natije ghoshit kiye; chhatra andolan ki Student List ko 250 me se 140 seatein mili jabki Vucic ki party ko 103 seatein mili, aur 14 saal ka shasan khatm ho gaya.
exam_angle: Chhatra andolan se sarkar badlav — loktantra aur Europe ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Saudi ne Pakistan ko $3 billion ki madad badhai
detail: Saudi Arabia ne Pakistan ke liye $3 billion ki vittiya suvidha ko uchit avadhi ke liye badha diya; vitt mantri Muhammad Aurangzeb ne sansad ke bahar iski pushti ki, jabki alag $5 billion ki suvidha 2028 tak badhi hui hai.
exam_angle: IMF aur videshi mudra bhandar — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: US midterms me Democrats ki badi jeet
detail: America ke midterm chunav me Democrats ne Senate aur House dono par kabza kar liya; 7 Senate seatein palti aur Michigan se Abdul El-Sayed desh ke pehle Muslim senator chune gaye.
exam_angle: America ki vibhajit sarkar aur 2028 ki daud — antarrashtriya rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Paraguay rashtrapati ne bank sankat par istifa diya
detail: Paraguay ke Rashtrapati Santiago Peña ne Ueno Bank ke dhahne ke baad istifa de diya; bank ke lagbhag 30 lakh grahakon ke khate band ho gaye aur unpar aapradhik jaanch aur mahabhiyog ki karyavahi shuru hui.
exam_angle: Bank niyaman aur rashtrapati ki jawabdehi — banking aur antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.
image_credit: Office of the President, Taiwan / CC BY 2.0

headline: Brooklyn me aag, 6 ki maut
detail: New York ke Brooklyn me ek ghar me lagi aag me 6 logon ki maut ho gayi aur 9 ghayal hue, jinme 3 firefighter aur 2 police adhikari shamil hain; aag ke kaaran ki jaanch chal rahi hai.

headline: Eisenkot ko 67 samarthan, Netanyahu peeche
detail: Israel me Yashar neta Gadi Eisenkot ko sarkar banane ke liye 67 sansadon ka samarthan mila, jabki Netanyahu ko 46 mile; Rashtrapati Herzog Ravivar ko faisla karenge.
exam_angle: Israel ki sansadiya vyavastha aur sarkar gathan — antarrashtriya rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: FATF ki scam compounds par badi report
detail: FATF ne scam compounds se jude avaidh vittiya pravah par nayi report jaari ki; har saal dasyon arab dollar ka nuksan hota hai aur lagbhag 120 case studies me 60 se zyada kshetron ko shamil kiya gaya.
exam_angle: FATF, money laundering aur cyber dhokhadhadi — banking aur arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Nithya Raman LA ki pehli Asian-American mayor
detail: Kerala me janmi Nithya Raman ne Los Angeles ke mayor chunav me maujuda mayor Karen Bass ko haraya; Associated Press ne unhe vijeta ghoshit kiya aur Bass ne haar maan li.
exam_angle: Bharatiya mool ki neta ka America ke bade sheher me chunav — pravasi Bharatiya aur America ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Trump ne kaha: mahabhiyog se Democrats barbaad
detail: America ke rashtrapati Donald Trump ne kaha ki mahabhiyog ki koshish se Democratic Party barbaad ho jayegi; unhe iski bilkul chinta nahi aur ve veto ka istemal karenge.
exam_angle: America me mahabhiyog ki prakriya aur vibhajit sarkar — antarrashtriya rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Asia bhar me girawat, Nikkei 6% gira
detail: America ki girawat ke baad Asia ke bazaaron me bhi badi girawat aayi; Japan ka Nikkei 6% gira, Taiwan 8% gira aur Hong Kong aur Shanghai bhi gire.
exam_angle: Asia ke share bazaar aur AI stock girawat — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Canada: 2027 se saalana 3.8 lakh PR
detail: Canada ne Budget 2026 ke saath 2027–2029 Immigration Levels Plan jaari kiya; 2027 se 2029 tak har saal 3,80,000 permanent resident ka lakshya hai, aur 2027 ke ant tak 2,00,000 tak asthayi nivaasiyon ko PR me badalne ka upaay bhi hai.
exam_angle: Canada ki aapravaasan neeti — antarrashtriya sambandh aur pravasi Bharatiya ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Europe bhar me bomb dhamki, Dublin-Rome flight divert
detail: Guruvar ko Europe bhar me ek darjan se zyada udanon ko bomb ki dhamki mili; Dublin se Rome ja rahi Aer Lingus flight ko France ke Évreux airbase par utarna pada, 151 yatri aur 6 crew surakshit rahe; adhikariyon ne inhe shararat bhari jhoothi dhamki bataya, koi khatarnak samagri nahi mili.
exam_angle: Europe me vimanan suraksha aur sankat prabandhan — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Ethiopia me hinsa, swasthya vyavastha khatre me
detail: WHO pramukh Tedros ne chetavni di ki uttari Ethiopia me hinsa se swasthya vyavastha dhahne ke kagar par hai; Amhara aur Tigray me drone hamlo me bachchon sahit nagrik mare gaye aur aspatalon me dawaiyon aur karmiyon ki kami hai.
exam_angle: WHO, sanyukt rashtra aur Ethiopia sangharsh — antarrashtriya sangathan aur manaviya sankat ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: US carrier Theodore Roosevelt Middle East ki ore
detail: Upgrah tasveeron ke mutabik USS Theodore Roosevelt 4 November ko South China Sea me dikha; US adhikariyon ke hawale se November ke ant tak Middle East pahunchne ki ummeed hai, jahan pehle se do carrier maujood hain.
exam_angle: US-Iran tanav: Hormuz se tel supply par asar — Bharat ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: France me lakhon ki hadtal, Eiffel Tower band
detail: Guruvar ko France bhar me mahangai ke khilaf hadtal aur pradarshan hue; grih mantralaya ke mutabik shaam 5 baje tak lagbhag 6 lakh log sadkon par the, aur Paris me Eiffel Tower aur Arc de Triomphe din bhar band rahe.
exam_angle: France me samajik andolan aur shramik hadtal — Europe ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Russell Brand balatkar ka doshi, saja Somvar
detail: London ki Southwark Crown Court ki jury ne comedian Russell Brand ko ek balatkar aur teen yaun hamlo ka doshi paya; do balatkar ke aaropon se use bari kar diya gaya, aur judge ne Somvar ko saja sunane se pehle use hirasat me liya.

headline: Brent $98 paar, tel me tez uchhal
detail: Hormuz me tanker hamlo aur Iran tanav ke beech Brent crude 3.88% chadh kar $98.29 prati barrel par band hua; Shukravar subah keemat $99 ke paas pahunchi, jabki UKMTO ke mutabik Ravivar se Khadi me kam se kam paanch jahazon se judi ghatnayein hui hain.
exam_angle: Tel ki keemat aur Hormuz — Bharat ki urja suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Ebola se sankramit British doctor London laya gaya
detail: Congo me Ebola se sankramit ek British doctor ko medical evacuation flight se London laya gaya; Royal Free Hospital ki high-level isolation unit me uska ilaj chal raha hai, aur UK sarkar ke mutabik aam janta ko khatra kam hai.
exam_angle: Ebola prakop aur swasthya vyavastha — antarrashtriya swasthya aur manaviya sankat ke liye mahatvapurna.
image_credit: CDC / Dr. Frederick A. Murphy (Public domain)

headline: Rubio ne Trump prashasan chhodne ki khabar nakari
detail: Bloomberg ki report ke mutabik Rubio midterm haar ke baad prashasan chhodne par vichar kar rahe the; Rubio ne New York Times se kaha Trump ka karyakal pura karna 'hamesha se meri yojana' rahi hai, aur White House ne report ko 'fake news' bataya.
exam_angle: America ki rajneeti aur Trump prashasan — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Trump: Russia-Ukraine samjhauta 'bahut kareeb'
detail: Trump ne White House me kaha Russia-Ukraine yuddh khatm karne ka samjhauta bahut kareeb hai aur isme pura Europe shamil ho sakta hai; unhone Putin ke doot Kirill Dmitriev se mulaqat ki pushti ki, jabki Abu Dhabi me 10-11 November ko trilateral baatchit tay hai.
exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh aur shanti vaarta — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.
